source_note: 证明正弦函数在整数上取值的序列的极限是不存在的
english_source_note: Nonexistence of a Limit for Sine on the Integers

strategies.callout_id: 证明正弦函数在整数上取值的序列的极限是不存在的#5
strategies.strategy_name_en: Use the Cauchy Necessary Condition via Successive Differences
strategies.summary_en: To show a sequence does not converge, test a necessary condition for being Cauchy: if $a_n$ converges, then $|a_{n+1}-a_n| \to 0$. Assume this holds and derive a contradiction by computing or estimating the successive differences.
strategies.applicability: Applies when a sequence has an explicit formula and the difference between consecutive terms is easy to analyze.
strategies.callout_body: 参考[[柯西收敛判别#^9993bc]]，序列成为柯西列的一个必要条件是差分的绝对值$|a_{n+1}-a_n|$收敛到0。那么序列$\sin(n)$满足这一条吗？我们不妨假设它满足，看看这会发生什么。

strategies.callout_id: 证明正弦函数在整数上取值的序列的极限是不存在的#6
strategies.strategy_name_en: Separate the Range into Two Positively Distanced Sets Across Periods
strategies.summary_en: Exploit periodicity by choosing two subsets $A,B$ of the range with positive mutual distance, then show that in each period there are integers landing in domain intervals mapped into $A$ and $B$. This yields two subsequences whose function values stay uniformly apart, preventing convergence.
strategies.applicability: Applies to nonconstant periodic functions sampled along integers or other discrete sets when each period contains sample points in separated regions of the graph.
strategies.callout_body: 由于函数的周期性，我们只要能够在$\sin(x)$的值域$[-1,1]$当中分离出两个集合$A,B$然后保证$$d(A,B):=\inf\{|x-y|:x\in A,y\in B\}>0$$然后在每个周期内保证$A,B$对应的定义域中的集集合$I_{A,k},I_{B,k}$当中各自至少包含一个整数$n_k,m_k$那么我们就可以保证$$|\sin(n_k)-\sin(m_k)|\geq d(A,B)>0,\forall k\in \mathbb{Z}^{+}$$我们这里可以加强命题，只需要考虑如果$|I_{A,k}|,|I_{B,k}|\geq 1$，那么其中一定会包含整数。
